draft.subject: Your two open questions — search and inviting a teammate
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Understood on taking another week to decide — no pressure from me. Both of your tickets are still open, so quick answers in the meantime:

On search: it's exact-match only today, and partial-word matching is on the roadmap. That's the current behaviour, not something broken on your account.

On your teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it helps your evaluation, I'm happy to walk through either one on a short call this week.

Best,
Chidi
